reason: The hypothesis directly combines the established finding that ultrafine grains improve oxidation resistance in AlCoCrFeNi (P5, P21, P26) with the known problem of fast-diffusing Mn forming non-protective scales in CrMnFeCoNi (P2, P25). It proposes a specific mechanistic competition—grain-boundary-enhanced selective diffusion of Cr/Al over Mn—to explain protective scale retention, which is a synthesis of two separate literature streams into a single testable prediction. The idea is not stated in any passage and goes beyond merely proposing the same experiment on a new alloy.

grain boundaries promote outward diffusion of Cr and Al to form protective chromia/alumina (P19, P21, P26)

Mn diffuses rapidly and forms non-protective outer oxides (P2, P25, P31)
